title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
author: Gabrielle Zevin
summary: Two childhood friends meet again as students and decide to build a video game together. Over three decades, their creative partnership brings fame, money and a lot of strain.
readIf: you like novels about friendship, ambition and creative work that care as much about games as about people.
skipIf: you want a traditional romance, since the central bond is more tangled and unresolved than that.

pairings.reason: Another novel steeped in video games, though much lighter and focused on adventure instead of human cost.
Follows another creative collaboration that thrives and then frays under pressure and feeling.
A quieter look at two people who repeatedly find and lose each other across years.
